chapter: Piano, Guitar Slim and personal life
title: Piano influences and the chords to Jock-A-Mo
summary: He never idolized anyone on piano, and the song had only two chords in G.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: Did you, uh, piano, you played piano, did you, did you, uh, listen to anybody? Like, did, did you, uh, try to play like Professor Long here?
I never tried to play like anybody. I just, I just liked to play piano, and I just played. I never really, uh, idolized anybody, really.
Do you remember the, do you remember the chords to, uh, Ico Ico, on the music one? Do you remember?

Mmm, mmm. What G was that? It was in G, and it was, uh, G, G, G, D. G? G, G, G, G, and G, D. That's all. G, mmm, Tynakin, Fifth. That was it. That was it. That's all. It was only two changes, you know.
